Dear Yunus,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding the issue with the charger displaying the "Hallo-Hello" screen, it is important to determine whether this occurs immediately after a firmware update or after some time. Unfortunately, since the charger is currently offline on SCB, I am unable to perform any remote analysis at this moment.
If someone is available on-site, I recommend requesting them to perform a local reboot, as this will be necessary to bring the charger back online. Alternatively, if the charger is connected to the OCPP server, a hard reset via the OCPP server may also be an option.
Thank you for your understanding, and please let me know if you need further assistance
With best regards,
